answer: Deposits are visible in gale, and opal reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 38% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 153 aliases, and each one needs its own funded echo account. A farm of 1258 identities would post 4865 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
